home.title: ChartDown App
home.tagline: Number charts for the whole band, with each player’s notes.

warnings.instrument-id: Instrument ids use lowercase letters, digits and -: “{id}”
warnings.no-section: Bars need a section first, like ## Verse 1
warnings.use-not-found: Can’t find an earlier section named “{name}”
warnings.beats-mismatch: Beats add up to {sum}, but the meter has {beats}
warnings.landmark-too-long: This lyric landmark has {words} words; keep it to {max} or fewer
warnings.unsupported-version: This chart says ChartDown {version}; this parser reads {supported}
warnings.header-not-closed: The header needs a closing --- line
warnings.use-with-rows: @use must be the only content line of a section; its own rows are kept
warnings.layer-no-section: Notes need a section first, like ## Chorus
warnings.layer-line: A layer holds only sections, bar headings and notes

profile.instrumentsHint: Choose any; you can change them whenever you like.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.explain: This deletes your account, your profile, your personal space and your private versions, for good. Your public versions stay with the community, credited to “ChartDown”. In bands you lead, the longest-standing member takes over as music director.
delete.mismatch: That email does not match your account.

errors.source_required: Choose a source: studio recording, live, acoustic or own arrangement.
